events.title: AAP Protests, Demands FIR Against Minister Parvesh Verma
events.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) protested and demanded an FIR against minister Parvesh Verma following a slapping incident. The party planned a demonstration at the Delhi Police headquarters.

events.title: Nepal Rains Cause Floods, Landslides, Killing 27
events.summary: Heavy rains in Nepal have led to widespread floods and landslides, resulting in at least 27 deaths and seven injuries. The disasters have affected multiple areas since September 24, with impacts also extending to bordering Indian states.

events.title: Godrej Properties launches Rs 6,000 crore luxury project in Mumbai
events.summary: Godrej Properties has launched a new luxury housing project in Mumbai's Marine Lines area. The project is expected to generate Rs 6,000 crore in revenue. This development strengthens the company's luxury portfolio in the Mumbai market.
